summary.text: Kevin Akin is the Peace and Freedom Party candidate for California State Assembly District 63 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Natasha Johnson (R).
A retired engineer and the chair of the Peace and Freedom Party of California, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was born and raised in Riverside.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Kevin Akin said he was born and raised in Riverside and worked as a carpenter for five years, a steelworker for ten years and a steam engineer in a hospital boiler room for more than 20 years before retiring.
He said he has been a member of four unions and active in community organizations including hobby clubs, his religious congregation and historic preservation efforts.
Akin said he filed as a write-in candidate after seeing that the incumbent had no opposition on the primary ballot, and advanced to the November ballot as one of the top two vote-getters.
He said he wants to represent working people in Sacramento and described himself as opposed to the Trump administration.
